caption: The image is a drawing of a pottery jar with a round, wide opening at the top and two small handles on opposite sides near the upper part of the vessel. The jar is a light to medium brown color with a slightly glossy surface. Decorative bands encircle the neck and the upper portion of the body, featuring textured patterns and stamped motifs. Below these bands, the jar is further adorned with blue designs forming symmetrical, heart-like shapes and dotted lines, interspersed with floral or leafy patterns. The lower section of the jar shows some irregular areas of color and a rough patch, indicating either wear or intentional texturing. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature, “E. WEIN,” appears in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
